text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we're targeting v2.3.0 final cut Friday 2025-04-11 17:00 PT. Need coordinated tags/branch bumps across repos: `redwood-api`, `redwood-runtime`, `redwood-console`, `redwood-sdk`. If you have open PRs that touch public surface, please flag here.
Maria Gomez: @Alex Chen, I have the SDK adapter PR (#412) — hoping to merge Thu AM, but there's one test flake. I can cut the SDK tag after merge and ping ops.
Jon Park: Re: changelog, who is owning release notes? I can draft a terse changelog, but need list of PRs to include.
Alex Chen: @Jon Park — can you take release-notes? I'll compile PR list from the tag commits. Also plan is: tag each repo with `v2.3.0`, run `release-tool generate` to produce entries.
Samir Patel: Quick Q: do we need to bump package.json versions in repo root or let the release tooling bump them? For runtime we usually bump manually because of docker tags.
Alex Chen: For console/sdk/api — let release tooling handle package.json bumps. For runtime, bump `imageVersion` in `deploy/helm/values.yaml` and create annotated git tag. Example checklist:
```
- merge PRs
- confirm CI green on main
- runtime: update deploy/helm/values.yaml -> imageVersion: v2.3.0
- run `./scripts/tag-and-publish.sh <repo>`
- push annotated tag `git tag -a v2.3.0 -m "v2.3.0"`
- run `release-tool generate --repo <repo>`
```
Linda Tran: Do we need backports to `stable` branch? Some customers are on 2.2.x.
Ryan O'Neill: I can do a patch release if there's a critical fix, but I'd rather keep stable untouched unless urgent. If backport required, note the PR numbers here and I’ll cherry-pick.
Maria Gomez: FYI test flake fixed, I re-ran CI. Will merge in ~2 hours and cut SDK tag then. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Release pipeline will be scheduled once all tags are pushed. Note: pipeline requires signed tags and passing `integration` job.
Alex Chen: Perfect — thanks all. I'll assemble PR list after Maria's merge and ping ops for helm/image rollout. I'll also add a short blurb in the release doc: https://redwood.example.com/release/v2.3.0. Ping me if you can't meet the cutoff.
Samir Patel: ci: the runtime `integration` job is flaky on GPU nodes; I'll keep watch and requeue if needed.
Alex Chen: OK closing loop — see you on Friday. :v:
